calibration.description: deterministic structural validation; no confidence or probability output exists

candidate.description: rdam.ibis (rdam 6.0.0): typed issue-position-argument structures validated under the gIBIS link grammar, organised into a deliberation map; input origin recorded as supplied or explicitly derived from a named upstream result; no extraction from text

compatibility.environment: pixi production environment (editable install of the single rdam distribution) and default environment; tests/ibis and production-boundary inspection
compatibility.evidence: pure Python, no I/O at import; the rdam distribution declares every runtime dependency in pyproject [project.dependencies]; production-boundary valid with rdam.ibis inside the one production package

licensing.licence: MIT (repository LICENSE; own code, no trained assets)

correctness_arguments: link typing: a (from-kind, relation, to-kind) triple is accepted exactly when the gIBIS table permits it (responds_to: position->issue; supports/objects_to: argument->position; generalizes/specializes/replaces: issue->issue; questions/is_suggested_by: issue->any); the table is rdam.ibis.grammar.GRAMMAR, transcribed in the module docstring from Conklin & Begeman 1988

attachment: after link typing, every position must respond to exactly one issue and every argument must support or object to exactly one position (rdam.ibis.grammar.ATTACHMENT); node ids must be unique and self-links are refused; a structure that breaks any rule is refused as malformed input, never repaired

the deliberation map is a pure re-organisation of the validated links (each issue with its positions, each position's supporting and objecting arguments, issue-issue relations) plus gap observations (issues without positions, positions without arguments, isolated nodes); no validity, strength, or acceptability is computed, so there is no judgement to be wrong about (FR-017: records what was said)

the provider never extracts a structure: extraction is always None; input_origin is 'supplied', or 'explicitly_derived' with the caller's named upstream result identity copied verbatim (FR-017); validation and the map are identical in both cases
property_tests: tests/ibis/test_grammar.py::TestLinkTyping::test_every_relation_by_kind_pair_is_accepted_exactly_when_the_grammar_permits_it (all 3 x 3 x 8 kind-kind-relation combinations against the table)
tests/ibis/test_grammar.py::TestAttachment (position exactly-one-issue, argument exactly-one-position, issues need no attachment)
tests/ibis/test_grammar.py::TestDeliberationMap (organisation without judgement, gap observations, exact payload round trip)

tests/ibis/test_provider.py (through the machine: supplied structure in, extraction is None, typed deterministic failure on a grammar violation, text-only request unavailable not failed, stale decision does not promote, explicitly derived input names its upstream result and still extracts nothing)
tests/machine/test_machine.py::TestLineage (a declared derivation becomes lineage naming the exact upstream artifact and both provider identities)

provenance.configuration_identity: gIBIS link grammar v1 (rdam.ibis.grammar.GRAMMAR and ATTACHMENT)

limitations: records supplied or caller-derived structures only; no extraction of issues, positions, or arguments from text (by design, FR-017)
the gIBIS grammar only: later IBIS dialects (e.g. Compendium's map, list, and decision nodes) are not represented
no argument strength or acceptability is computed; formal evaluation of an argument graph is the Dung provider's job
strengths: grammar verdicts checked against the table for every kind-kind-relation combination
malformed structures are refused with a typed, deterministic failure rather than repaired or guessed at
the map records the deliberation as given and names its gaps without judging it
supplied versus explicitly derived input is recorded, never inferred; extraction is always None
recommendation.summary: Replace the previous rdam.ibis source with the same grammar plus explicit input-origin recording: the gIBIS link grammar implemented exactly, type table checked exhaustively, attachment rules enforced, deterministic, measured latency, no licensing constraint.
